Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		suspendedUsers: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0),
		expiredUsers: Set(User) = suspendedUsers->select(u|u.SuspensionDays = 1)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		suspendedUsers->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1) and
		expiredUsers->forAll(u: User|u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND)
}
